accounting.title: Accounting export
accounting.intro: A general journal for your accounting software (QuickBooks Online, Xero or Sage): one balanced journal per closed business day. Give each item your own account code first.
accounting.accountsIntro: Only items used in the period you export need a code. Leave a code empty to clear it.
accounting.name: Account name for {{item}} (optional)
accounting.missing: These need an account code first: {{items}}
accounting.lastClosed: Closed business days up to {{date}} can be exported.
